map.平面闸门启闭力计算，考虑自重、水压力摩擦阻力及水柱下压力: From gate self-weight, upstream/downstream head difference, seal friction coefficient and water-column downforce, compute opening and closing forces to check hoist capacity.

map.水闸启闭力 = 总水压力 + 摩擦: Sluice gate opening/closing force = total water pressure + friction
map.💡 水压力 P=½·ρg·H²·B；摩擦力 T=f·P；启门力 F₁=K(G+T: 💡 Water pressure P=½·ρg·H²·B; friction T=f·P; opening force F₁=K(G+T+W_column); closing force F₂=G−T−W_column
map.摩擦系数参考：钢对钢 0.15~0.25，钢对混凝土 0.3~0.5，胶木滑块: Friction coefficient reference: steel on steel 0.15–0.25, steel on concrete 0.3–0.5, bakelite slider 0.10–0.15
map.水柱高度 hw 用于考虑门顶水柱下压力，无水柱时填 0: Water-column height hw accounts for downforce of the water column above the gate; enter 0 when there is no water column.
map.启门力安全系数 K 取 1.2~1.5，本工具默认取 1.3: Opening-force safety factor K is 1.2–1.5; this tool defaults to 1.3.
map.本公式为简化计算，实际工程应按《水利水电工程钢闸门设计规范》SL74核算: This is a simplified formula; for actual engineering verify per SL 74 Design Code for Hydraulic Steel Gates.
map.📚 深度解析：水闸启闭力计算: 📚 In-depth: Sluice Gate Open/Close Force Calculator
map.平面闸门按水压力加摩擦定启闭机容量。: Plain gates size the hoist capacity from water pressure plus friction.
map.动水与静水闭门力分别校核。: Check dynamic- and static-water closing forces separately.
map.选型预留安全系数防卡阻。: Reserve a safety factor in selection to prevent jamming.
map.总水压力 ≈ γ·h_c·A = 9.81×1.5×(5×3) ≈ 220.7: Total water pressure ≈ γ·h_c·A = 9.81×1.5×(5×3) ≈ 220.7 kN; adding seal and support friction gives an opening force sized at the 300 kN class.
map.支承摩擦系数 0.1 时附加力约 22 kN，占水压力一成，选型不可忽略。: At a support friction coefficient of 0.1 the added force is about 22 kN, ~10% of water pressure, which cannot be ignored in selection.
map.静水闭门力小，动水下行因水动力学增大，按最不利工况选型。: Static-water closing force is small; dynamic-water downward force grows from hydrodynamics — select for the worst case.
map.按计算启门力乘 1.2~1.5 安全系数，并核对闭门力是否自落。: Multiply the computed opening force by a 1.2–1.5 safety factor and check whether the closing force allows gravity drop.
map.水闸启闭力计算工具用于平面闸门启闭机选型时的启门力与闭门力估算。综合考虑闸门自重: The sluice gate open/close force tool estimates opening and closing forces when selecting a hoist for a plain gate. Considering gate self-weight, friction from upstream/downstream water pressure, and water-column downforce on top of the gate, it computes the required opening and closing forces and judges whether counterweight is needed.
